subject: AI & Agents
title: Where AI Stands Today
description: A micro-lesson that makes Where AI Stands Today usable.

hook.text: AI writes code, diagnoses disease, drives cars, and composes symphonies. Yet it still can't make coffee.

buildup.text: We're in an era of rapid capability growth but also growing awareness of limitations.

discovery.text: AI is reshaping every industry while raising questions about jobs, privacy, and control.

twist.text: The gap between what AI can do and what people think it can do has never been wider.

climax.text: We're somewhere between tool and revolution — and nobody agrees on which.

punchline.text: The future of AI is being written right now — by us.

quiz.question: What is a key challenge of AI today?
options: The gap between AI capabilities and public expectations
AI is no longer being researched
All AI models have become identical

details.summary: AI today excels at language, vision, and specific reasoning tasks but lacks general intelligence, common sense, and true understanding. We are in a period of unprecedented capability with significant limitations.
details.whyItMatters: An accurate snapshot of current AI helps navigate hype and fear. Understanding both what AI can and cannot do today guides personal, business, and policy decisions.
takeaways: AI excels at narrow tasks and pattern recognition at scale
General intelligence and true understanding remain absent
We are in a period of rapid progress with clear limitations

faq.question: What can AI do well today?
faq.answer: Language generation, translation, image creation, medical image analysis, code writing, game playing, protein structure prediction, and pattern recognition across many domains are current AI strengths.

faq.question: What are AI's biggest limitations today?
faq.answer: Reliable reasoning, common sense, causal understanding, physical world interaction, and maintaining factual accuracy remain major weaknesses. AI also struggles with novel situations outside its training distribution.
